title: SafeSpit Scenario
description: Input document for the deterministic SafeSpit simulation. Both the Dart (Android) and TypeScript (website) implementations MUST validate every incoming Scenario against this schema and produce a SimulationResult that matches shared-spec/result.schema.json to floating-point tolerance.

schemaVersion.description: Semver of this scenario contract. Both implementations pin the version they support and reject mismatches with a clear error.

seed.description: 6-character hex string that fully determines wind, target placement, and any mode-specific random elements. Case-insensitive on input; implementations SHOULD normalize to uppercase.

id.description: Stable vehicle identifier (snake_case). The Car profile id MUST be 'car'.

turbulenceFactor.description: Multiplicative modifier on the (v / speedStepKmh) term of the proven pitch formula. Car = 1.0 (identity).

angleBias.description: Additive degrees applied after the base formula and clamp. Car = 0.0 (identity).

windSensitivity.description: Multiplier on the wind-driven deviation applied to impactPosition. Car = 1.0.

difficulty.description: 0.0 = trivial, 1.0 = expert. Used by mode-specific scoring weights.

displayName.description: Human-facing name (e.g. 'Car', 'Bus', 'Train'). Fictional, no realism required.

speedKmh.description: Vehicle speed in km/h. Negative values are invalid; implementations MUST clamp to 0.0 before applying the pitch formula (D-14).

pitchDeg.description: Actual device pitch (integrated gyroscope Y-axis) at the moment of the simulation tick.

rollDeg.description: Roll angle. The reference build uses 0.0; the field exists for Phase B.

yawDeg.description: Yaw angle. The reference build uses 0.0; the field exists for Phase B.

headingDeg.description: Compass heading. 0 = North. The reference build uses 0.0; the field exists for Phase B.

windSpeedKmh.description: Wind speed. If not explicitly set by the caller, implementations MUST derive it deterministically from the scenario seed (D-11).

windDirectionDeg.description: Wind direction (where the wind is coming from, 0 = North). If not explicitly set, derived deterministically from the seed.

targetDistanceM.description: Distance to the simulated target (Spit Olympics). If not explicitly set, derived deterministically from the seed.

mode.description: Game mode. Determines which scoring weights, HUD elements, and simulation variants apply.
